answer: To claim a seat, a factory-serialized quartz oscillator is clamped over a spirit lamp on a surveyed bench. As it warms, a schlieren camera records the thermal plume while the applicant must whisper a one-time phrase into a contact mic bonded to the same crystal, locking the piezoelectric trace to the plume frames and serial. That signed bundle is posted as a slashable bond. Reusing a serial or splicing another voice fails the thermal-acoustic coincidence and burns the stake. A hundred fake identities therefore cost a hundred genuine crystals, a hundred bench slots, and every lost bond.
